stage_2_story.text_en:
On Sunday morning, David had an important work event — a formal lunch with clients from abroad. He opened his wardrobe and tried to choose the right outfit. He decided on his dark grey suit, a white shirt, and a blue tie.

When he took the shirt out of the wardrobe, he noticed it was full of wrinkles. He set up the iron and carefully ironed the shirt, paying extra attention to the collar and the sleeves. The fabric was quite delicate, so he used a low heat setting.

Before the event, David also went to a clothing shop to buy a new belt. He was not sure about his size, so the shop assistant helped him. David tried a few options in the fitting room and chose a brown leather belt that matched his shoes perfectly.

The dress code for the event was formal, but at the office earlier that morning it had been casual Friday. David felt a little strange changing from jeans and a T-shirt into a full suit, but he knew it was the right choice for the occasion.

When he arrived, his boss complimented him on his outfit. David felt confident and well-prepared for the meeting.
